Replaced with a single continuous 14.70s interview answer from the intended Tom Baker, explicitly credited in both BBC source titles. Native actual-candidate review confirms one speaker, complete usable words, no music, crowd, effects, acoustic discontinuity, splices or cutoffs. Secondary ASR corroborates the substantive words; native hearing adds audible er hesitation omitted by ASR, retained literally. Mild natural hesitation accepted. Native guessed studio/interior context although BBC metadata places interview outdoors; location guess is not relied on, while observed clean isolated acoustics are. Younger recording age explicitly disclosed in provenance. Final corpus pass pending.

replacement_provenance.title: 1975: TOM BAKER on DOCTOR WHO | South Today | Classic Interviews | BBC Archive
replacement_provenance.source_basis: Publisher-uploaded BBC Archive interview; original project source is BBC Doctor Who clip explicitly titled The Eleventh Doctor Meets The Curator (Tom Baker). Replaces scored multi-speaker montage with a continuous response from the same intended actor.
replacement_provenance.identity_basis: Both original and replacement publisher titles explicitly credit Tom Baker. Reviewer receives anonymous audio only.
replacement_provenance.age_context: Replacement is a younger 1975 interview voice; original is the older Curator performance. Preserves intended actor rather than exact scene/age delivery.
